text:
sara_sales: Heads-up — BigBank procurement/legal asked for our DPA + confirmation we support SCCs, plus details on DSARs/data deletion for a POC. They also want CAIQ/SIG. Meeting with their infosec Tue morning. Can someone share quick, shareable answers?

alex_security: We have a standard DPA (https://redwood.ai/legal/dpa) and we support EU SCCs. For vendor risk evidence: SOC 2 Type II, redacted pen-test report, and CAIQ/SIG pack are in the vendor portal. I can pull a prefilled CAIQ — expect ~3-5 business days for a complete, annotated response (can expedite top sections).

michael_privacy: GDPR quick notes: Redwood acts as a processor per the DPA. For DSARs — controllers (the customer) submit to their org admin; we expose a deletion endpoint and provide deletion receipts. Default artifact/log retention is 30 days; Dedicated/Private customers can set retention to 0 or to a custom policy.

elaine_solns: For the POC: recommend synthetic or anonymized data + VPC peering. If they must use live data, run the POC on Dedicated/Private with customer-managed KMS. I can draft a POC runbook + checklist (env, retention settings, KMS, scope) and include a step-by-step DSAR/cleanup flow.

sara_sales: Procurement also asked: are model outputs or request/response payloads persisted, and for how long? Also: are payloads encrypted at rest/in transit?

alex_security: Request/response payloads are encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. By default we persist request/response artifacts for 30 days for debugging/quality; this can be disabled for enterprise Dedicated/Private. Model weights are immutable and not treated as customer PII. KMS/HSM integrations available for key control.

michael_privacy: DSAR flow detail: customer triggers a deletion via the admin console or API -> we run a deletion job that removes data from active stores and queues caches/KV for purge. We return a signed confirmation within our DSAR SLA (typically 5 business days). For EU->US transfers we apply SCCs as documented in the DPA; subprocessors list included in the DPA appendix.

elaine_solns: I'll own the POC runbook. Rough checklist: 1) Signed DPA + subprocessor appendix, 2) Dedicated env with VPC peering, 3) Retention set to 0 for request logs, 4) KMS integration + key ownership, 5) Provide CAIQ deliverable. Draft runbook by EOD tomorrow.

vendor-risk-bot: New vendor package uploaded: CAIQ v2.1, SOC2 Type II summary, redacted pen-test 2025-02. Access: https://vendor.redwood.ai/portal/BigBank-pack (token-protected).

sara_sales: Great — two asks for next steps: @alex_security can you confirm CAIQ timeline and whether we can expedite specific sections before Tue? @elaine_solns can you send the POC runbook and a POC cost/credit estimate? I'll loop in legal.

alex_security: Can expedite high-priority CAIQ sections (data transfers, encryption, subproc list) in ~48h. Full CAIQ completion is ~7-10 business days if we need every question annotated. Please paste which sections BigBank flagged and I'll prioritize.

elaine_solns: Will send runbook + POC pricing proposal. Typical offer: up to $10k in credits for enterprise evals (flexible). Scheduling a sync for Wed 10am to align on technical and legal asks.

sara_sales: Thanks all — I'll reply to BigBank with the timeline and ask them to mark the CAIQ sections they care about. :thumbsup:
